normalization_contract: Canonical semantic payload = the full dataclass output of the pipeline call (TradeSignal+PostAsianDecision for FX; SetupState+BTCSweepResearchProposal for BTC; tuple of LargeSMCResearchDecision for Large-SMC), serialized via post_asian_pilot.fingerprint.fingerprint() (sort_keys=True, stable separators, default=str for datetimes). No field is excluded -- every run used a fixed, explicitly-injected timestamp/session context (no wall-clock, no randomness, no network), so there is no run-specific field (generated_at/run_id/etc.) to strip.
